# Settings

Guide for **Settings** APIs in Giddh.

## Authentication

Send `Auth-Key` or `Session-Id`. Base URL: `https://api.giddh.com`.

## Open in API Reference

Full request/response schemas: [Settings](/p/settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Endpoints in this module (5)

- [Get Company Settings](/p/get-company-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Update Company Settings](/p/update-company-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Get User Company Entry Settings](/p/get-user-company-entry-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Update User Company Entry Settings](/p/update-user-company-entry-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Update User Settings](/p/update-user-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Notes

- Prefer endpoint pages for exact query params, body fields, and examples.
- For voucher / business-document flows, pass `voucherVersion=2` when the endpoint documents it.
